# Summary
### Chapter Key Takeaways

- References borrow data without transferring ownership.
- Aliasing XOR Mutability: either multiple `&T` or exactly one `&mut T`.
- Dangling references are prohibited at compile time.
- Slices (`&[T]` and `&str`) provide fat-pointer views (pointer + length) into contiguous memory without allocation.
